construct: PAX2 encodes a transcription factor required for normal embryonic development of the kidneys and eyes. Loss of functional PAX2 can disrupt formation of renal tissue and the optic nerve, producing congenital kidney abnormalities with optic nerve coloboma; inheritance is autosomal dominant when a pathogenic PAX2 variant is present.

realism_gate.gratuitous_rarity: PASS_NONE — the paired kidney/optic-nerve developmental phenotype makes the construct educationally specific rather than gratuitously obscure.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Bilateral hypoplastic kidneys with chronic kidney disease plus bilateral optic nerve colobomas and an affected father identify the autosomal dominant PAX2-related renal coloboma syndrome.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Alport syndrome can combine renal and ocular disease, but its renal phenotype is classically hematuric glomerular disease and its ocular findings are not optic nerve colobomas. ADPKD and ARPKD produce cystic kidneys, and tuberous sclerosis produces hamartomatous lesions rather than this developmental eye-kidney pair.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The optic nerve coloboma plus renal hypoplasia is a highly specific developmental combination for PAX2-related renal coloboma syndrome.
